hadith:
Sales and Trade - Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar:

Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If somebody sells pollinated date palms, the fruits will be for the seller unless the buyer stipulates that they will be for himself (and the seller agrees).
message: Allah will gather humanity for resurrection, and the verse describes lasting safety from Hellfire as a grace from Him. Let this hope inspire gratitude and righteous living, and honor clear agreements in trade.
name:
Al Jaami' - الْجَامِعُ - The Gatherer

The name Al Jaami' reflects God's power to gather all beings and souls, emphasizing His ultimate control over the universe and the resurrection of humanity. This concept is rooted in Islamic teachings about the Day of Judgment, where all individuals will be resurrected and held accountable for their actions.
verse:
Ad-Dukhan - The Smoke - 44:56-57

There they will never taste death, beyond the first death. And He will protect them from the punishment of the Hellfire—

as ˹an act of˺ grace from your Lord. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph.
